approval.scope: pre-register a prospective SROT v2 hardware gate while row-softmax S5 runs independently

motivation.interpretation: The relative 1.25x gate answers whether SROT is nearly cost-free versus hard pooling. V2 asks the distinct prospective systems question of whether SROT fits the independently specified 4GB and 72-hour deployment budget.
motivation.forbidden_use: Observed v1 treatment latency may motivate the new question but may not calibrate the v2 threshold.

frozen_configuration.precision: bfloat16 activations with FP32 transport reductions

v2_hardware_gates.throughput_derivation: 8*4096 source points / 50000 points per second; the 50000 target predates S5 and was the original CAMO hardware throughput requirement.
v2_hardware_gates.projection_rule: Use measured median dataloader-inclusive epoch wall time after one warmup epoch, multiplied by 50 epochs and 3 seeds.
v2_hardware_gates.relative_latency_vs_hard: report as a diagnostic; no longer a v2 hard gate
v2_hardware_gates.transport_only_latency: report median and dispersion as a diagnostic; never substitute it for end-to-end model-step latency

decision_rule.hardware_pass: All v2 hardware gates and unchanged mathematical gates pass in one immutable benchmark artifact.
decision_rule.if_pass: SROT v2 becomes eligible for an exploratory representation-only study; confirmatory segmentation still requires a separately frozen comparison plan.
decision_rule.if_fail: Keep SROT excluded from the main architecture and retain the negative systems result.
decision_rule.row_softmax_independence: This mutation cannot block, alter, or reinterpret the already-authorized S5 row-softmax confirmatory arm.

forbidden_shortcuts: changing the 1e-5 tolerance or 100-iteration cap after timing
excluding topology, pushforward, decoder, backward, or optimizer work from the end-to-end model-step gate
using repeated identical geometry as a warm-start benchmark
changing batch size, point count, proxy count, support degree, or precision after inspecting v2 timing
rewriting or deleting any v1 negative artifact
